name: Harry S. Truman Farm Home

dates.note: Wikipedia: the farm house was 'built in 1894-95 after the 1867 house was destroyed by fire'; its infobox prints 'Built 1867' for the farm property. Truman lived there 1906-1917; his nephew's 1991 interview (NPS) 'talks about the modifications made to the house to make it "modern"'.

The Library item id was not found (two loc.gov queries returned other Missouri surveys), so no data page was fetched and no survey block is recorded.
